assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and lightheadedness consistent with supraventricular tachycardia, occurring against a background of known atherosclerotic heart disease of the native coronary artery.
Mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring (CPT 93229) was ordered to capture intermittent arrhythmic events and correlate these symptoms with rhythm disturbances in an outpatient setting.
The service directly addresses the identified indication for Mobile Cardiac Telemetry monitoring.
The diagnoses on file (I47.1, I25.10) support the medical necessity of this diagnostic monitoring service.
The denial under Reason Code CO-197 is contested because the service was medically necessary for the patient's documented condition.
